class.name: ReloadedPluginServer
class.brief_description: The plugins of Rails Reloaded the library runs.
class.description: Creates the plugins when the library starts, runs their stages (see [ReloadedPlugin]) and frees them when it ends.

method.name: data_path_resolve
method.description: Returns the path a data file is found under, relative to [param base_dir], as the plugin that resolves the data's paths reads it (data written for a case-insensitive filesystem, say). Without such a plugin, [param relative_path] as it is.

method.name: plugin_get_list
method.description: Returns the plugins, in the order they were created.
